name: ask-install-chrome-devtools
label: Install the chrome-devtools CLI?
description: Asks the person whether to install the chrome-devtools CLI, only when it is missing.

exe_data.prompt: The chrome-devtools CLI is required to continue
exe_data.detail: It lets agents drive and debug a real browser window on this computer. It doesn't appear to be installed. Would you like to install it now?
